request_summary: Replace the CI-environment check in the hook-test runner with an explicit --require-bash flag so a machine that merely exports CI (as this harness does) still gets the local skip instead of a hard failure.
rationale: C0: 1 edit-target files in one package, no one-way door (1 edit-target files / 0 package(s) (root pseudo-package excluded, Q1 2026-08-21) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=brownfield)
entry_point: The exact-file test command (invoked by `npm test`) on a Windows machine without a usable bash
done_oracle: `node scripts/run-hook-tests.js` exits 0 and prints the SKIPPED banner on a machine without bash even when the ambient environment exports CI=1; `node scripts/run-hook-tests.js --require-bash` exits 1 naming the three unrun suites; with a working bash both forms run all three suites and propagate the first failure.
no_single_gate_reason: The script is itself the gate; executing it in this environment is the whole check. The bash-present branch cannot be exercised here because no working bash exists on the machine.
